description.en: Copy of local anticoagulant management pathway, with explicit reference to the current ESGE/BSG anticoagulant-in-endoscopy guideline.
Annual audit of compliance with pathway across all EMR cases in the prior 12 months.

provenance.reason: Concrete evidence specs Evideris designed for the M3 Centre Accreditation evidence-pack generator. NOT published by ESGE — the source standard (text) is verbatim from Tate EMR 2023 Rec 2 sub-item, but the evidence-required list is Evideris's operationalisation of what compliance proof looks like.
